# Fazal Ali

> Dr. Fazal Ibrahim Ali — writer, scholar, and founder of Omeros AI. Critical theory in artificial intelligence, written from Trinidad & Tobago.

Fazal Ali is a Cambridge Commonwealth Scholar and former Provost of the University of Trinidad and Tobago. His work bridges Caribbean philosophy, capability theory (after Amartya Sen and John Rawls), and the politics of large language models. Omeros AI is his studio and brand identity.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Biography, mentors, and academic record of Dr. Fazal Ibrahim Ali.
- [Education for Liberty](/education-for-liberty): The book — a monograph after Sen and Rawls, with a flippable preview, PDF, and Amazon link.
- [Omeros AI](/omeros-ai): The studio and brand identity — a Caribbean reading of intelligence.
- [Journal](/writing): Long-form essays on AI, education, ecology, and inequality.
- [Ecology](/ecology): A West Indian reading of climate, coast, and curriculum.
- [Inequality](/inequality): A capability reading of inequality from a West Indian classroom.
- [Palimpsest](/palimpsest): Layered writings on memory, language, and the colonial archive.
- [Podcast](/podcast): Conversations on critical theory in AI.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Images from the practice.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach Dr. Ali.
